title: 她主张十月加息：市场却在押注降息，能源价格成关键理由
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: For me, what really becomes an issue is those high energy prices start seeping into lots of other consumer prices, because energy is such an important input.
segments.zh: 对我来说，真正成为问题的是那些高能源价格开始渗透到许多其他消费价格中，因为能源是如此重要的投入。

segments.en: And also with the trade war with Canada, I'm less convinced that the terror frades are where they are and may be coming down, like there's a chance they'd go up.
segments.zh: 而且与加拿大的贸易战，我不太相信关税会保持在当前水平并可能下降，反而有可能上升。

segments.en: So I think it's just this concern that I have risk to the upside.
segments.zh: 所以我认为这只是我担心上行风险。

segments.en: And you did hear when we got the minutes from the September meeting, risk management was the most typical, the most common reason that was given among committee members.
segments.zh: 你们确实听到了，当我们得到9月会议纪要时，风险管理是委员会成员给出的最典型、最常见的原因。

segments.en: So I agree with that. I'm applying that same logic to October and I think there's a case for a hike there too.
segments.zh: 所以我同意这一点。我将同样的逻辑应用于10月，我认为也有理由加息。

segments.en: Claudia, you'd have to, like, listening to you and just thinking about what the market has done, it's hard to make the case that the market even disagrees with you, even though it's not pricing in a hike because it was to a large extent before we heard from Fed
segments.zh: 克劳迪娅，听你说并思考市场已经做了什么，很难说市场甚至不同意你的观点，尽管它没有定价加息，因为在听到美联储发言之前，很大程度上已经定价了。

segments.en: speakers. Something like 70% odds that we would be getting a hike this week.
This is a Fed chair that wants markets to be listening to the data, not to FOMC officials, how far away in a world are we to that reality?
segments.zh: 这位美联储主席希望市场倾听数据，而不是FOMC官员，我们离那个现实有多远？

segments.en: Well, I think we got to judge the Fed on their actions, not necessarily their words.
segments.zh: 嗯，我认为我们必须根据美联储的行动来判断，而不一定是他们的言辞。

segments.en: Kevin Warson said he doesn't want to give forward guidance, but we had the, you know, President of the New York Fed and the vice chair of the board come out in one week and
segments.zh: 凯文·沃森说他不想提供前瞻性指引，但我们有纽约联储主席和董事会副主席在一周内出来说

segments.en: really talk down those odds of an October hike.
segments.zh: 确实压低了十月加息的可能性。

segments.en: And those two members, that's the part of Troika, the leadership team at the Fed, the chair is the third person in Troika.
segments.zh: 而这两位成员，正是美联储领导团队三巨头的一部分，主席是三巨头中的第三位。
